I can see you live in the UK with both children. Let me gather some information about your circumstances to assess your eligibility.

You mentioned that you have recently moved to the UK and your right-to-reside position is uncertain. This is an important factor for Child Benefit eligibility. Could you please provide more details about your immigration or residency status? For example:

- Are you a British citizen?
- Do you have settled or pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme?
- Are you an EEA or Swiss national?
- Do you have another type of visa or immigration status?
- Have you been granted indefinite leave to remain?

Understanding your right-to-reside status will help me determine whether you meet the eligibility requirements for claiming Child Benefit.
